question: With the same model, endpoint and effort, what does playing under the pi coding-agent CLI instead of the wrathbench loop change in the progress, the stalls and the tokens sent per call of ninety minutes of play?
note: The pi probe campaign (operator, 2026-10-20: wrathbench stays the reference harness, harnesses plug into one seam, and the reference changes only if a probe campaign says to). The harness is chosen by the assignment, not the arm: the definition has one arm, and the store row assigns two roster entries for the same model id, deepseek-flash on the DeepSeek platform (api.deepseek.com), one on the wrathbench driver and one on the pi driver, so the model, the endpoint and an existing wrathbench baseline are shared (operator, 2026-10-20). Both entries name thinking effort high, because pi asks for high on deepseek-flash when no effort is set while the wrathbench driver then sends no level at all (operator, 2026-10-20). The arm runs the release build harness-0.5-1587-g66cd7749, pinned by digest, so both assignments run one build, the pi 1.3.0 it carries included; a pinned arm runs only in a run pod. pi compacts at a fixed 300k-token window (operator, 2026-10-20), stamped as a run dimension: it is the pi entry's compactWindow and not an arm argument, because an arm's --compact-window would be refused for both assignments (the wrathbench driver has no compaction window, and the pi entry already sets one). pi 1.3.0's catalogue gives deepseek-flash a 1,000,000-token window, so 300k binds: it reaches pi as reserveTokens 700000 and pi compacts above 300,000 tokens, where its own threshold would be 983,616. The same reserve caps the summary pi asks for, which 300k lifts from about 13k tokens to the model's 384k output cap, a ceiling and not a length; tying the cap to the reserve is accepted (operator, 2026-10-20). wrathbench compacts nothing; its trim-and-fold window is its context policy. pi's own model-facing text (the notice on an MCP result cut at 20 KB, the re-issue text after a reply hits its output cap, and the framing of a compaction summary) is stock and part of what the pi label means, not patched (operator, 2026-10-20). The clock is e90's ninety minutes, the cheaper of the two scored clocks, and the one the wrathbench entry's e90 history was played on. A window changes nothing until the context has grown past it, and whether a pi run passes 300k in ninety minutes has not been measured: if none does, this version compares the two loops without a compaction, and a longer clock is a new version. The leash is otherwise a probe's: idle 20 minutes, the no-XP watchdog off as in every definition so far (where e90 runs it at 20 minutes), and e90's 3000-call guard. No level ends a run: the model's e90s under the wrathbench loop have ended near level 5, so the clock is the end. resume is false: a resumed pi run starts a fresh pi with none of its history, a compaction to nothing that no window chose, and a scored e90 never resumes either; a paused run is a spent attempt and the next starts fresh. One cell, human-paladin, the start the model's scored wrathbench runs were played from, so its e90 history reads beside the wrathbench assignment.

cells.note: The start the deepseek-flash entries' scored runs were played from.

arms.note: The release build both assignments run; the assignment chooses the harness.
